L24: # Registries - Schedule Run
L25: 
L26: Service:
L27:     Container Registry
L28: 
L29: API Version:
L30:     2019-04-01
L31: 
L32: ##
L33: 
L34: Schedules a new run based on the request parameters and add it to the run queue.
L35: 
L36:     `POST https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/{registryName}/scheduleRun?api-version=2019-04-01`
L37: ## URI Parameters
L38: 
L39: Name  | In  | Required  | Type  | Description
L40: --- | --- | --- | --- | ---
L41: registryName  | path  | True  | string minLength: 5
L42: maxLength: 50
L43: pattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9]*$  | The name of the container registry.
L44: resourceGroupName  | path  | True  | string minLength: 1  | The name of the resource group to which the container registry belongs.
L45: subscriptionId  | path  | True  | string  | The Microsoft Azure subscription ID.
L46: api-version  | query  | True  | string  | The client API version.
